item.text:
{
  "proposals": [
    {
      "actors": [
        "SFC, which authorises funds and may designate a fund as complex on a case-by-case basis.",
        "Fund manager, which reviews classification and communicates with distributors.",
        "Distributor, which applies the prevailing complex-product sale requirements.",
        "Investors to whom the fund is distributed."
      ],
      "classification_assumptions": [
        "Assessment concerns one SFC-authorised fund for public offering in Hong Kong; listed closed-ended alternative asset funds are excluded from this circular.",
        "Direct exposure, indirect exposure and NAV are measured on a consistent basis at the relevant assessment time. Their amounts are supplied as exact integers in a common accounting unit without rounding across the 50% boundary.",
        "The measurement methodology and treatment of layered exposures must be established separately; the circular does not supply a complete calculation method.",
        "An operative SFC designation is a separate institutional act. Risk factors or potential scrutiny alone do not establish that designation.",
        "The result identifies a complex-product classification basis under this circular, not overall distribution compliance or legal approval."
      ],
      "missing_information": [
        "Is the fund authorised for public offering in Hong Kong, and is it a listed closed-ended alternative asset fund?",
        "What are the direct exposure, indirect exposure and NAV at the relevant assessment time, and what methodology establishes comparable amounts without inappropriate double counting?",
        "Has the SFC designated this fund as complex, and is that designation operative at the assessment time?",
        "What effective date, measurement frequency and treatment of temporary threshold crossings apply? The retained text does not specify them.",
        "What additional classification or sale requirements apply under the referenced instruments, including the separate LAF circular and prevailing complex-product distribution requirements?"
      ],
      "objects": [
        "The assessed fund as the product distributed.",
        "Direct investments in private credit or private equity.",
        "Indirect exposure through intermediary investments or financial instruments, including BDCs, CLOs, TRSs and SRTs.",
        "Underlying private market assets, distinguished from the intermediary instruments.",
        "Fund NAV used as the threshold denominator.",
        "An SFC case-specific designation and its period of operation.",
        "Offering documents and communications to distributors."
      ],
      "reading": {
        "assumptions": [
          "Assessment concerns one SFC-authorised fund for public offering in Hong Kong; listed closed-ended alternative asset funds are excluded from this circular.",
          "Direct exposure, indirect exposure and NAV are measured on a consistent basis at the relevant assessment time. Their amounts are supplied as exact integers in a common accounting unit without rounding across the 50% boundary.",
          "The measurement methodology and treatment of layered exposures must be established separately; the circular does not supply a complete calculation method.",
          "An operative SFC designation is a separate institutional act. Risk factors or potential scrutiny alone do not establish that designation.",
          "The result identifies a complex-product classification basis under this circular, not overall distribution compliance or legal approval."
        ],
        "citations": [
          {
            "quote": "This circular provides guidance to management companies of funds that are authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong (Funds)6 in this regard.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u4.564"
          },
          {
            "quote": "A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
          },
          {
            "quote": "On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
          },
          {
            "quote": "In assessing whether the complex product designation is warranted7, the SFC will adopt a holistic approach taking into account the specific circumstances of the case.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u29.4630"
          },
          {
            "quote": "7 In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"
          },
          {
            "quote": "6 Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs).",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"
          },
          {
            "quote": "A Fund classified as a complex product will be subject to the SFC’s prevailing requirements for the sale of complex products8 including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"
          },
          {
            "quote": "Fund managers are encouraged to consult the SFC at the earliest opportunity if they are in doubt regarding complex product classification of their Funds.",
            "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u49.6955"
          }
        ],
        "distinction": "The mandatory 50% test aggregates direct and indirect exposure at fund level. Below 50%, the listed factors support SFC discretion rather than automatic classification; an actual designation must be distinguished from circumstances that could justify one. LAF exclusion is a scope exclusion, not a finding that the product is non-complex. Missing exposure or designation evidence remains unknown. Classification timing is also distinct from the instruction to update existing funds’ documents as soon as practicable.",
        "family": "scope",
        "formalization": {
          "facts": [
            {
              "meaning": "The assessed fund is authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong at the assessment time.",
              "name": "authorised_public_fund",
              "requires_judgment": false,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u4.564"
              ],
              "type": "bool",
              "unit": "Boolean per fund at assessment time"
            },
            {
              "meaning": "The assessed fund belongs to the category of listed closed-ended alternative asset funds excluded by footnote 6.",
              "name": "is_laf",
              "requires_judgment": true,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"
              ],
              "type": "bool",
              "unit": "Boolean per fund at assessment time"
            },
            {
              "meaning": "Direct exposure to private market assets, measured using the established exposure methodology and expressed exactly in the same accounting unit as indirect exposure and NAV.",
              "name": "direct_exposure",
              "requires_judgment": true,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u1.5",
                "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
              ],
              "type": "integer",
              "unit": "Common exact accounting units"
            },
            {
              "meaning": "Aggregate indirect exposure to private market assets through all relevant intermediary investments and financial instruments, measured using the established methodology in the same accounting unit as direct exposure and NAV.",
              "name": "indirect_exposure",
              "requires_judgment": true,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u1.5",
                "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779",
                "d4148dd852cee.u59.7979"
              ],
              "type": "integer",
              "unit": "Common exact accounting units"
            },
            {
              "meaning": "The fund’s NAV at the assessment time, expressed exactly in the same accounting unit as both exposure amounts.",
              "name": "fund_nav",
              "requires_judgment": true,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
              ],
              "type": "integer",
              "unit": "Common exact accounting units"
            },
            {
              "meaning": "The SFC has made a case-specific designation of this fund as a complex product that is operative at the assessment time. Absence of evidence does not establish false.",
              "name": "operative_sfc_designation",
              "requires_judgment": true,
              "source_unit_ids": [
                "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779",
                "d4148dd852cee.u29.4630",
                "d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"
              ],
              "type": "bool",
              "unit": "Boolean per fund at assessment time"
            }
          ],
          "result": "(or (>= (+ direct_exposure indirect_exposure direct_exposure indirect_exposure) fund_nav) operative_sfc_designation)",
          "result_type": "bool",
          "scope": "(and authorised_public_fund (not is_laf) (> fund_nav (integer 0)))"
        },
        "local_id": "classification_basis",
        "questions": [
          "Is the fund authorised for public offering in Hong Kong, and is it a listed closed-ended alternative asset fund?",
          "What are the direct exposure, indirect exposure and NAV at the relevant assessment time, and what methodology establishes comparable amounts without inappropriate double counting?",
          "Has the SFC designated this fund as complex, and is that designation operative at the assessment time?",
          "What effective date, measurement frequency and treatment of temporary threshold crossings apply? The retained text does not specify them.",
          "What additional classification or sale requirements apply under the referenced instruments, including the separate LAF circular and prevailing complex-product distribution requirements?"
        ],
        "statement": "[TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Within scope, does the fund meet a complex-product classification basis under this circular at the assessment time? True means aggregate direct and indirect exposure is at least 50% of NAV, or an operative SFC case-specific designation exists. False means neither basis is present on established facts; it does not establish non-complex status under other requirements. Unknown inputs remain unknown unless the other branch independently establishes true. An excluded fund receives no classification conclusion from this model.",
        "subject": "Fund-level complex-product classification for distribution"
      },
      "relationships": [
        "The fund holds direct investments and intermediary instruments; intermediary instruments provide indirect exposure to underlying private market assets.",
        "Direct and indirect exposure amounts are aggregated and compared with the same fund’s NAV.",
        "The SFC may designate the fund below the numerical threshold after holistic consideration of the case.",
        "The manager communicates classification-relevant information to distributors, which apply the prevailing sale requirements once the fund is classified.",
        "The separate 15% direct-investment limit is not a replacement for the aggregate 50% classification threshold."
      ],
      "schema_id": "fund_classification.scope_time.v1",
      "temporal_basis": "One fund at a specified distribution assessment time, using contemporaneous comparable exposure and NAV measurements and any designation operative then. The retained text supplies no explicit effective date, averaging window, reassessment cadence or automatic declassification rule.",
      "unit_of_assessment": "The entire fund as a distributed product, aggregating all relevant direct and indirect private-market exposures; individual holdings and investor transactions are not separate threshold units."
    }
  ],
  "unresolved": [
    "No prior models were supplied for comparison. The present model explicitly separates underlying assets, intermediary instruments, aggregate exposure, SFC designation and its timing; the retained evidence does not require a rival threshold interpretation.",
    "The SFC’s holistic discretion cannot be derived as an automatic Boolean decision from its non-exhaustive factors. Strategy, portfolio, liquidity, risk, instrument characteristics and home-regulator conditions inform discretion but supply no deterministic weighting or cutoff.",
    "The three missing dependencies have no supplied substantive text. Their effects, and any additional classification routes under referenced instruments, remain unresolved.",
    "The formula requires exact commensurable integer measurements and positive NAV. If those prerequisites cannot be established, this formalization cannot decide the threshold; no rounding or zero-NAV rule is inferred."
  ]
}
